_about: Score errata: places where the printed score disagrees with the recording (or the score reader misses a part), confirmed by ear. 'pitch' entries change one melody note's pitch (matched by its final audio time, within 0.06s, and its written pitch), applied after the score clock. 'missing_parts' entries add notes the PDF reader can't see (score seconds), joined into the lead before the key layout. 'merge' entries join one part's notes starting in [start, end) (score seconds) into a single held note on 'midi' (a sustain the score reader splits). 'missing_notes' entries add a note the score reader drops from a part (score seconds), before anything reads the score.

pitch.why: Intro pan flute, 2nd held note: the score has E (up a half step from the E-flat before it); the recording plays D, a step DOWN (D about 2x the E in the recording; quiet passage). Approved by ear Nov 12.
Same figure an octave lower: score E, recording D (D about 10x the E in the recording). Approved by ear Nov 12.

merge.why: m.53 (2:37): the score reader gives G#4 (1.9 s) then A4 (2.2 s), but the recording holds one unchanging note for the full 4 beats, as at every other repeat of this passage (the Warm Pad also holds one chord throughout). A misread accidental mid-tie. Confirmed by ear Nov 12.

missing_notes.why: Celesta 2 plays Celesta 1's bell figure as a strict canon a dotted quarter (0.75 s) later; in this figure the parsed Celesta 2 part has no high G where the canon puts it (Celesta 1's G at 87.375). The other repeats of the figure have it, and it is audible in the recording. Confirmed by ear Nov 12.
